related.title: Chandrayaan-1 月球探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學精度目標 60 m，較大基線模型通過，但須另證明遮蔽及匹配品質可接受。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a 60 m teaching target the larger baseline passes the model, subject to acceptable occlusion and matching quality. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 從反射光譜計算吸收帶深度，區分光譜指標與唯一礦物判定。
related.differenceEn: Calculate spectral band depth and distinguish an index from unique mineral identification.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學高度 H=100 km、基線 B=20 km、焦距 f=1000 pixel、視差誤差 σd=0.2 pixel。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：σh=100²×0.2/(1000×20) km=0.1 km。 結果約 100 m。近似垂直攝影中 σh≈H²σd/(fB)，f 與 σd 必須使用相同像面單位；不處理遮蔽。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成帶中心反射率 0.16，兩側內插連續譜 0.20。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：D=1−0.16/0.20。 結果約 0.2 fraction。帶深 D=1−R帶/R連續譜；須先校正熱輻射與觀測幾何，連續譜不能為零。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching H=100 km, baseline B=20 km, focal length f=1000 pixels and disparity uncertainty 0.2 pixels. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: σh=100²×0.2/(1000×20) km=0.1 km. Result ≈ 100 m. For near-nadir stereo σh≈H²σd/(fB); f and σd must share image-plane units. Occlusion is excluded.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic band-center reflectance is 0.16 and interpolated continuum 0.20. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: D=1−0.16/0.20. Result ≈ 0.2 fraction. Band depth D=1−Rband/Rcontinuum requires thermal and geometric correction and a nonzero continuum.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: ATV 自動補給太空船
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：若教學精度目標 60 m，較大基線模型通過，但須另證明遮蔽及匹配品質可接受。 每項結論須附輸入、單位、版本與未解限制。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: For a 60 m teaching target the larger baseline passes the model, subject to acceptable occlusion and matching quality. Attach inputs, units, revision and unresolved limitations to each conclusion.
related.difference: 用二維誤差橢圓評估接近位置是否符合教學監視範圍。
related.differenceEn: Assess approach-position consistency using a two-dimensional error ellipse.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學高度 H=100 km、基線 B=20 km、焦距 f=1000 pixel、視差誤差 σd=0.2 pixel。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：σh=100²×0.2/(1000×20) km=0.1 km。 結果約 100 m。近似垂直攝影中 σh≈H²σd/(fB)，f 與 σd 必須使用相同像面單位；不處理遮蔽。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。合成殘差 x=0.3 m、y=0.4 m，σx=0.2 m、σy=0.2 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：q=(0.3/0.2)²+(0.4/0.2)²。 結果約 6.25 dimensionless。獨立二軸下 q=(x/σx)²+(y/σy)²；這是正規化殘差平方，不是以公尺表示的距離。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Teaching H=100 km, baseline B=20 km, focal length f=1000 pixels and disparity uncertainty 0.2 pixels. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: σh=100²×0.2/(1000×20) km=0.1 km. Result ≈ 100 m. For near-nadir stereo σh≈H²σd/(fB); f and σd must share image-plane units. Occlusion is excluded.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Synthetic residuals are x=0.3 m, y=0.4 m with σx=σy=0.2 m. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: q=(0.3/0.2)²+(0.4/0.2)². Result ≈ 6.25 dimensionless. For independent axes q=(x/σx)²+(y/σy)² is squared normalized residual, not distance in meters.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
